payload.name: Savri
payload.description: 网站数据与下一步操作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Savri or Besökskollen account to explore visitors, traffic sources, pages, goals and funnels for sites you can access. Connect Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools in the site dashboard to read search clicks, impressions, queries, pages and trends. Google uses the shared site connection; Bing uses your own connection for each site. Search reports are available from Basic. The OAuth connection needs no API key; the separate API-key/npm route requires API access from Growth. Reports preserve each provider’s date coverage and limits. Bing weekly Web reports differ from its daily traffic totals. These tools do not provide separate AI citation counts or link a search query to a person or order. Search reports are read-only; managing sites, goals, funnels or event properties requires write permission.
payload.longDescription:
连接您的Savri或Besökskollen账户，以查看您可访问网站的访客数据、流量来源、页面信息、目标和转化漏斗。
在站点仪表盘中连接Google搜索控制台或Bing网页管理员工具，可读取搜索点击量、展示量、搜索关键词、页面数据和趋势。
Google使用共享站点连接；Bing为每个站点使用独立连接。
搜索报告从基础版即可使用。
OAuth连接无需API密钥；独立API密钥/npm路径需要Growth提供的API访问权限。
报告会保留各服务商的日期覆盖范围和数据限制。
Bing每周网页报告与每日流量总量存在差异。
这些工具不提供单独的AI引用次数，也无法将搜索关键词与具体用户或订单关联。
搜索报告为只读状态；管理网站、目标、转化漏斗或事件属性需要写入权限。

payload.name: Writrex SEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Writrex SEO audits public webpages in ChatGPT and turns technical SEO signals into clear, prioritised actions.

Analyse page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, indexability, headings, content, links, image alt text, social metadata and structured data. Use the returned evidence to identify on-page SEO issues, understand what matters most, and create practical implementation checklists for a webpage.

Connect your Writrex SEO account to run audits using your available audit credits.
payload.longDescription:
Writrex SEO 会在 ChatGPT 中审核公开网页，并将技术 SEO 信号转化为清晰且按优先级排列的行动建议。

分析页面标题、元描述、规范 URL、可索引性、标题层级、内容、链接、图片替代文本、社交元数据和结构化数据。利用返回的证据识别页面 SEO 问题、判断重点，并为网页制定切实可行的实施清单。

连接 Writrex SEO 账号，即可使用可用的审核额度运行检查。

payload.name: Hologrow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hologrow makes your connected commerce, advertising, analytics, and ERP data available for analysis. Explore performance, compare channels, investigate changes, and create reports using natural language.

Hologrow supports a wide range of platforms, including Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Meta Ads, GSC, and more. It provides read-only data access and does not modify your campaigns, product listings, orders, store settings, or other source data.
payload.longDescription:
Hologrow 将已连接的电商、广告、分析和 ERP 数据用于分析。用自然语言探索表现、比较渠道、调查变化并创建报告。支持 Amazon Seller

Central、Amazon Ads、Google Ads、GA4、Meta Ads、GSC 等平台。仅提供只读数据访问，不会修改活动、商品列表、订单、店铺设置或其他源数据。

payload.name: UniCourt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search over 400 million state and federal cases in plain English to quickly and easily locate on-point cases, view case details, and access relevant information. Identify key participants (parties, judges, and counsel) and review the docket history to understand what happened in any case.

To use the plugin, users must have an active subscription with UniCourt. For access, please contact the UniCourt team at sales@unicourt.com.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言搜索超过 400 million 件州和联邦法院案件，快速、轻松地找到相关案件、查看案件详情并获取相关信息。识别关键参与者（当事人、法官和律师），并查看案卷历史，了解案件经过。

使用此插件需要拥有有效的 UniCourt 订阅。如需访问权限，请联系 UniCourt 团队：sales@unicourt.com。

payload.name: Agentio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agentio is the AI-native platform for Creator advertising. Brands buy Creator media across YouTube, Meta, and beyond. 

This connector answers questions about your own Agentio account without opening the dashboard. 

Ask about performance on either platform. On YouTube: views, spend, CPM, view-through rate, 30-day views, link clicks and QR scans, and conversion reporting with cost per acquisition, revenue, and return on ad spend grouped by campaign, ad group, Creator channel, source, or attribution level. On Meta: per-ad performance and rollups, demographic breakdowns, and weekly reach. "What did we spend per acquisition last quarter?" becomes a question rather than a report you assemble. 

It also carries Agentio's product documentation, so "How is a 30-day view counted?" is answered from the same source as our help content instead of guessed at.

Access is read-only and scoped to a single brand, chosen when you sign in and enforced on Agentio's servers. A connection cannot change your data or reach another brand's account, and you can revoke it at any time from Agentio's integration settings. 

Requires an Agentio account.
payload.longDescription:
Agentio 是面向创作者广告的 AI 原生平台。品牌可在 YouTube、Meta 等平台购买创作者媒体广告。

此连接器无需打开控制面板，即可回答与你自己的 Agentio 账户相关的问题。

询问任一平台的表现。在 YouTube 上：查看播放量、支出、CPM、观看率、30 天播放量、链接点击和二维码扫描，以及包含每次获客成本、收入和广告支出回报率的转化报告，可按广告活动、广告组、创作者频道、来源或归因层级分组。在 Meta 上：查看单条广告表现及汇总、受众人口统计细分和每周覆盖人数。“我们上个季度每次获客花了多少钱？”变成一个问题，无需自己拼凑报告。

它还包含 Agentio 的产品文档，因此“30 天播放量如何计算？”会依据与帮助内容相同的来源回答，而不是猜测。

访问权限为只读，并限于登录时选择的单个品牌，由 Agentio 服务器强制执行。连接无法修改数据或访问其他品牌的账户，你可随时在 Agentio 集成设置中撤销连接。

需要 Agentio 账户。

payload.name: LocationLists
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LocationLists compiles the complete list of locations a brand publishes in its own official store or dealer locator — Bobcat, Caterpillar, STIHL, Generac, Home Depot, Waffle House and 260+ more — plus licensed trade contractors by state and association member directories. Ask for a brand or a type of location, see how many records exist and which fields each row carries (name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, latitude, longitude, website and brand-specific fields such as dealer tier or product lines), check when the file was last rebuilt, and view ten real rows. Full datasets are downloaded from locationlists.com.
payload.longDescription: LocationLists整理了品牌在其官方门店或经销商定位系统中发布的完整地址列表——包括Bobcat、Caterpillar、STIHL、Generac、Home Depot、Waffle House等260余家品牌——以及按州划分的持牌贸易承包商信息和协会成员目录。输入品牌名称或地点类型，可查看现有记录数量及每行数据包含的字段（名称、地址、城市、州、邮政编码、电话、纬度、经度、网站以及经销商等级、产品线等品牌特定字段），查看文件最后一次重建时间，并预览十行真实数据。完整数据集可从locationlists.com下载。

payload.name: Net Zero Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research and assess emerging climate and energy markets directly within your AI tool. Discover and screen companies, compare competitors and vendors, conduct first-pass due diligence, build market maps, identify relevant investors, analyse funding activity, and explore commercial agreements, infrastructure projects and corporate activity using Net Zero Insights data.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 AI 工具中研究和评估新兴气候与能源市场。使用 Net Zero Insights 数据发现和筛选公司、比较竞争对手和供应商、进行初步尽调、构建市场地图、识别相关投资者、分析融资活动，并探索商业协议、基础设施项目和企业活动。

payload.name: Dash Social
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your brand intelligence into every AI workflow. The Dash Social plugin connects your brand, performance, competitive, and community intelligence directly to ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying data between platforms, ChatGPT gets the real-time brand context it needs to deliver more relevant, on-brand recommendations and actions. That means your team can keep working with the AI tools they use today, while Dash Social provides the trusted brand intelligence needed to drive better results.
payload.longDescription: 将品牌智能融入每个AI工作流程。Dash Social插件可将你的品牌、表现、竞争和社区洞察直接连接至ChatGPT。无需手动在平台间复制数据，ChatGPT即可获取实时品牌背景信息，从而提供更相关且符合品牌调性的建议和行动方案。这意味着你的团队可以继续使用当前的AI工具，同时Dash Social提供可信的品牌智能，以实现更优成果。

payload.name: DolphinX
payload.description: 查看 SEO 和 AI 搜索数据
payload.summaryOriginal: View your SEO & AI search data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DolphinX connects your SEO and AI search (LLMO) monitoring data to ChatGPT. Ask about your search rankings, how often your brand is mentioned or cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview and other AI answers, how you compare to competitors, and why AI recommends you (or doesn't). Access is read-only and limited to exactly what you can already see in your own DolphinX account.
payload.longDescription: DolphinX 将你的 SEO 和 AI 搜索（LLMO）监测数据连接到 ChatGPT。你可以询问搜索排名、品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Overview 和其他 AI 回答中被提及或引用的频率、与竞争对手相比的情况，以及 AI 为何会（或不会）推荐你的品牌。访问仅为只读，且严格限定为你在自己的 DolphinX 账户中已能查看的内容。

payload.name: RainVis Hourly Weather Charts
payload.summaryOriginal: How much will it rain and when
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RainVis turns hourly weather data into an interactive seven-day forecast chart. It shows rain probability together with forecast accumulation for each hour, helping people distinguish a slight chance from expected measurable rain and understand whether the forecast suggests drizzle, steady rain, heavy rain, or a downpour. Users can inspect any of the next seven days, scrub through individual hours, and customize the chart with temperature, wind, cloud cover, pressure, humidity, dew point, and air quality.
payload.longDescription: RainVis 将逐小时天气数据转化为交互式七天预报图表。它会显示降雨概率以及每小时的预报累积降水量，帮助人们区分小概率降雨与预计会出现的可测量降雨，并了解预报意味着毛毛雨、持续降雨、大雨还是倾盆大雨。用户可以查看未来七天中的任意一天，逐小时拖动浏览，并使用温度、风、云量、气压、湿度、露点和空气质量自定义图表。

payload.name: MoSPI
payload.description: 印度 NSO MCP 服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT with Official Statistics of India. The list of available datasets can be seen at https://datainnovation.mospi.gov.in/mospi-mcp
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到印度官方统计数据。可在 https://datainnovation.mospi.gov.in/mospi-mcp 查看可用数据集列表。

payload.name: ECDB
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 ECDB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your ECDB subscription directly in ChatGPT. Access the full power of ECDB's e-commerce market intelligence — based on billions of real transactions and thousands of other sources — without leaving your workflow. Query retailer revenues, market sizes, category rankings, and transaction KPIs across 100+ countries. Benchmark competitors, size markets, identify top-performing retailers, and research market entry opportunities. Transaction-based, not survey-based. Updated monthly. Ideal for strategy teams, analysts, consultants, and anyone who needs reliable e-commerce data fast.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ECDB 订阅查询电商市场情报：覆盖 100 多个国家的零售商收入、市场规模、品类排名和交易 KPI，用于竞争对标、市场规模评估和进入研究。数据基于真实交易，每月更新。

payload.name: LouisianAI
payload.description: 研究路易斯安那州 AI 项目
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LouisianAI helps people research Louisiana AI and data-center infrastructure from a public, source-governed tracker. It can summarize the tracker, list records, retrieve project or Louisiana Public Service Commission docket details, search and retrieve canonical evidence, and compare two projects. Every tool is read only, requires no account, and returns bounded public results with confidence, source links, and explicit uncertainty. The tracker summary includes a compact inline card; every workflow remains usable without custom UI.
payload.longDescription: LouisianAI 帮助用户通过一个公开、来源可追溯的追踪平台，研究路易斯安那州的 AI 和数据中心基础设施。你可以查看追踪器摘要、列出记录、调取项目或路易斯安那州公共事业委员会案卷详情、搜索和获取权威证据，以及比较两个项目。所有工具均为只读、无需账户，并返回范围受限的公开结果，其中包含可信度、来源链接和明确的不确定性说明。追踪器摘要包含紧凑的内嵌卡片；所有工作流程都无需自定义界面即可使用。

payload.name: Farmbit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Farmbit brings field-specific satellite and temporal evidence into ChatGPT so orchard teams can decide where to scout first and what still needs ground confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Farmbit 将针对具体田块的卫星和时间序列证据带入 ChatGPT，帮助果园团队决定优先巡查哪些区域，以及哪些情况仍需实地确认。

payload.name: smart-me
payload.description: 读取电表和电动汽车充电数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.

You can ask what a meter reads right now, how much a heat pump or an apartment used over a period, what that costs at the current tariff, when the daily peak was, and how consumption developed over days or months. It reads quarter-hourly load profiles and daily series, the folder structure of a site, EV charging stations with their sessions and settings, load management groups, and the tariffs and consumption behind a building's energy bill.

With your confirmation it can also make changes: rename meters, create and organise folders, switch a relay, send a command to a charging station, set charging current limits, and set up the tariffs and units used to bill self-consumption in a shared building. Every change is shown to you before it happens. Deleting a folder or a charging station takes two steps, and the second one requires the exact name.

You need a smart-me account and sign in with it. Long series of measured values need a smart-me Professional licence; single readings work on any account. The app acts only inside your own account, with your own permissions, and stores nothing.
payload.longDescription:
smart-me 是一款建筑计量平台。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到 smart-me 账户，让你无需打开门户网站，也能用日常语言询问仪表数据。

你可以询问仪表当前读数、热泵或公寓在某段时间内的用量、按当前费率计算的费用、每日峰值出现时间，以及用电量在数天或数月间的变化情况。它会读取每刻钟的负荷曲线和每日数据序列、站点文件夹结构、电动汽车充电站及其会话和设置、负荷管理组，以及用于计算建筑能源账单的费率和用量。

经你确认后，它还可以执行更改：重命名仪表、创建和整理文件夹、切换继电器、向充电站发送命令、设置充电电流上限，以及配置共享建筑中用于结算自发自用电量的费率和单位。每项更改都会在执行前展示给你。删除文件夹或充电站需要两个步骤，且第二步必须提供确切名称。

你需要拥有 smart-me 账户并登录。查询长时间范围的测量数据需要 smart-me Professional 许可；任何账户都可查看单次读数。此应用仅在你自己的账户及权限范围内操作，不会存储任何数据。

payload.name: PerceptionX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PerceptionX helps employer-brand, talent-acquisition, and communications teams understand how leading AI platforms describe their organization. Explore employer perception scores, sentiment, visibility, recurring themes, cited sources, competitor mentions, market differences, and quarterly trends using the data available in your connected PerceptionX organization.
payload.longDescription: PerceptionX 帮助雇主品牌、人才招聘和传播团队了解领先 AI 平台如何描述其组织。使用已连接 PerceptionX 组织中的数据，探索雇主认知分数、情绪、可见度、反复出现的主题、引用来源、竞争对手提及、市场差异和季度趋势。

payload.name: Data Market
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consulte preços, disponibilidade e histórico de produtos no varejo online no Brasil. Compare o mesmo produto entre redes, lojas e canais, encontre onde está mais barato e acompanhe a variação de preços ao longo do tempo. A Data Market reúne dados coletados diariamente em mais de 250 redes de supermercados, atacarejos e varejistas regionais. O acesso aos dados e recursos disponíveis depende do plano da conta Data Market de cada usuário.
payload.longDescription: 查询巴西在线零售商品的价格、库存和历史。比较不同连锁店、商店和渠道中的同一商品，找到最便宜的购买地点，并跟踪价格随时间的变化。Data Market 每天收集来自 250 多家超市、批发超市和区域零售商的数据。可访问的数据和功能取决于每位用户的 Data Market 账户套餐。

payload.name: TopicLift Editorial Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TopicLift Editorial Copilot gives publishers a read-only conversational interface to their TopicLift workspace. Ask about realtime and historical traffic, top and declining articles, Google Search, Google Discover, Google News, aggregate search queries, and evidence-backed editorial opportunities. Recommendations include editorial themes, supporting metrics, confidence, and proposed titles or angles. The integration is scoped to the authenticated TopicLift workspace and cannot edit articles, WordPress, settings, or reports.
payload.longDescription: TopicLift编辑助手为出版商提供了一个只读对话式界面，用于访问其TopicLift工作区。可询问实时和历史流量、热门和下降中的文章、Google搜索、Google发现、Google新闻、汇总搜索查询以及有证据支持的编辑机会。推荐内容包括编辑主题、支持性指标、信心指数以及提议的标题或角度。该集成仅限于已认证的TopicLift工作区，无法编辑文章、WordPress内容、设置或报告。

payload.name: RainbowStats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RainbowStats helps users retrieve, transform, analyze, and visualize economic and financial time-series data in conversation. It provides access to FRED and other public databases and supports statistical scripting, regression, correlation, forecasting, distribution analysis, and interactive charts.

Results include reusable RainbowStats scripts so users can reproduce or extend their analysis on rainbowstats.com. RainbowStats is intended for research and educational purposes and does not provide investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
该插件经济数据与统计。以下功能和限制适用：

RainbowStats helps users retrieve, transform, analyze, and visualize economic and financial time-series data in conversation. It provides access to FRED and other public databases and supports statistical scripting, regression, correlation, forecasting, distribution analysis, and interactive charts.
Results include reusable RainbowStats scripts so users can reproduce or extend their analysis on rainbowstats.com. RainbowStats is intended for research and educational purposes and does not provide investment advice.

payload.name: Churn Solution
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Churn Solution's MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your cancellation and retention data. Using natural language, investigate why customers leave, measure the impact of your cancel flows, identify at-risk accounts and revenue, track retention trends, and answer complex questions about your subscription business.

Built for founders and growth, product, and finance teams, it turns Churn Solution data into actionable retention insights and faster decisions.
payload.longDescription:
Churn Solution 的 MCP 服务器让 AI 助手安全访问您的取消和留存数据。使用自然语言调查客户离开的原因、衡量取消流程的影响、识别有风险的账户和收入、跟踪留存趋势，并回答有关订阅业务的复杂问题。

它面向创始人以及增长、产品和财务团队，将 Churn Solution 数据转化为可执行的留存洞察和更快决策。

payload.name: viral.app
payload.description: 用户生成内容分析与创作者运营
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: viral.app tracks and analyzes UGC performance across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your viral.app workspace: query tracked account and video analytics, build leaderboards and KPI reports, manage tracking, organize content with tags and tag workflows, read Creator Hub campaigns, and pull live platform data when you need current numbers. Sign-in runs through OAuth and is scoped to one viral.app organization; tools that spend billable credits always quote their cost first and only execute after you confirm. Requires a viral.app account with API access.
payload.longDescription:
viral.app可在TikTok、Instagram、YouTube和Facebook上追踪并分析用户生成内容的表现。
此插件将ChatGPT和Codex连接到您的viral.app工作区：查询已追踪账号和视频分析数据，创建排行榜和KPI报告，管理追踪设置，通过标签和标签工作流整理内容，查看创作者中心活动，并在需要时获取实时平台数据以获得最新数据。
登录通过OAuth进行，并限定于一个viral.app组织；消耗可计费积分的工具会先显示费用，经您确认后才执行。
需要具备API访问权限的viral.app账户。

payload.name: CryptoSocials
payload.description: 为代理人的加密货币X研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research stored Crypto X discussions with your agent. Discover which assets are being discussed, explore author history, filter by known chain associations, and follow source links to inspect the evidence. Start with whole-period summaries, narrow questions with compact results, and retrieve detailed posts when needed. Compare discussion activity and inspect available price history.

A CryptoSocials account is required. Research uses your shared CryptoSocials credit balance across MCP, REST API and Archive. Coverage is the stored archive, not all of X. Missing prices or posts do not mean nothing happened. Your agent interprets the evidence; CryptoSocials does not provide trading predictions or execute trades.
payload.longDescription:
通过您的代理存储加密货币X的讨论内容。
发现正在被讨论的资产，查看作者历史记录，按已知链关联进行筛选，并跟踪来源链接以检查相关证据。
从完整周期摘要开始，通过精简结果缩小问题范围，必要时可检索详细帖子。
比较讨论活跃度并查看可用的价格历史记录。

需要拥有加密社交账户。
研究会使用您在MCP、REST API和存档功能中的共享加密社交信用余额。
覆盖范围是存储的档案内容，而非X平台的全部数据。
价格或帖子缺失并不意味着未发生任何事情。
您的代理会解读相关证据；加密社交不提供交易预测或执行交易。

payload.name: ProfileID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProfileID is a trusted digital career profile powered by GenuineIN. It connects verified education, skills, competencies, experience, credentials, projects, certifications, and career evidence into one intelligent profile. Through ChatGPT, users can securely access and use their ProfileID data for career guidance, skill-gap analysis, job readiness, resume and portfolio creation, opportunity matching, and personalized career recommendations.
payload.longDescription: ProfileID 是由 GenuineIN 提供支持的可信数字职业档案。它将经过验证的教育经历、技能、能力、工作经验、资质、项目、认证和职业证明整合到一个智能档案中。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以安全地访问和使用自己的 ProfileID 数据，获得职业指导、技能差距分析、求职准备评估、简历和作品集制作、机会匹配及个性化职业建议。

payload.name: Blockworks
payload.description: 查找加密货币和区块链数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring market data, fundamentals, research, news, signals, events, and fundraising data directly into your investment workflows. Power your models, dashboards, alerts, and AI agents with one integrated source of crypto intelligence.
payload.longDescription: 将市场数据、基本面、研究、新闻、信号、活动和融资数据直接带入投资工作流程。通过一个集成的加密货币情报来源，为模型、看板、提醒和 AI 智能体提供支持。

payload.name: Adzviser Amazon Seller Central
payload.description: 与 Amazon 销售数据对话
payload.summaryOriginal: Talk to your Amazon sales data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Amazon Seller Central data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track sales, monitor orders, and see how your products are performing across marketplaces.

Compare ordered product sales, units ordered, sessions, and buy box percentage across date ranges. Break results down by ASIN, SKU, marketplace, or fulfillment channel. Turn your seller data into clear reports, spot trends, and see which listings are driving revenue.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Adzviser 将 Amazon Seller Central 数据连接到 ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，跟踪销售、监测订单，并查看产品在各市场的表现。

比较不同日期范围内的已订购商品销售额、订购数量、访问次数和购买按钮占比。按 ASIN、SKU、市场或履约渠道拆分结果。将卖家数据转为清晰报告，发现趋势，了解哪些商品刊登在带来收入。

payload.name: Parse.ly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Parse.ly is the content analytics platform that publishers and marketing teams use to see how their content performs. This app connects ChatGPT to your Parse.ly account, so you can ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers from your real data.

Ask which posts did best this week, where your traffic comes from, how a specific article performed, which authors or sections lead, how many readers are on the site right now, and how your campaigns, conversions, goals and headline tests are doing. You can also search your posts, authors, sections, tags and campaigns, look up Parse.ly documentation, and manage goals and saved groups.

Sign in with your existing Parse.ly login. The app only sees the sites and data you can already see in the Parse.ly dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
Parse.ly 是出版商和营销团队用来了解内容表现的内容分析平台。此应用连接 ChatGPT 与 Parse.ly 账户，你可以用自然语言询问网站，并获得基于真实数据的答案。

询问本周表现最佳的文章、流量来源、特定文章表现、领先作者或栏目、当前网站读者数量，以及营销活动、转化、目标和标题测试的表现。还可以搜索帖子、作者、栏目、标签和活动，查询 Parse.ly 文档，并管理目标和保存的群组。
使用现有 Parse.ly 登录信息登录。应用只能看到你在

Parse.ly 仪表板中已有权限查看的网站和数据。

payload.name: DoveVannoINostriSoldi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore the Italian public data available on DoveVannoINostriSoldi. Discover datasets, filters and coverage, then query public spending, revenue, benefits and other indicators with their sources, periods, units and limitations. The service is read-only: it does not make payments or change data. Each data snapshot has its own reporting period and update date. Online sources may be temporarily unavailable. Differences or unusual values do not prove waste, fraud or individual responsibility.
payload.longDescription: 探索 DoveVannoINostriSoldi 的意大利公共数据，查询支出、收入、福利等指标及来源、期间、单位和限制。只读，不付款或改数据；数据快照有各自报告期和更新时间，异常不代表浪费、欺诈或个人责任。

payload.name: ConvRadar: CRO for GA4
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ConvRadar finds where your site loses conversions and ranks what to fix first.

Connect your Google Analytics 4 property and ask for an audit. ConvRadar reads your own GA4 data and returns headline KPIs against the previous period, the biggest drop-off in your funnel, anomalies with significance testing, and 2-5 ranked findings, each matched against a curated library of 184 CRO hypotheses across 43 categories, built from published conversion research.

What you can do:
- Run a full conversion audit in one prompt
- Find the biggest leak in your funnel, and which segments caused it
- Compare mobile vs desktop, paid vs organic, or any two segments, with a significance test
- Check any page for load speed and mobile UX problems, no GA4 needed
- Benchmark your conversion rate and AOV against your industry
- Log the changes you ship and measure whether they actually helped

ConvRadar reads only aggregated GA4 metrics from the property you connect. It never reads raw user-level data, and never reads your ChatGPT conversations.

Built for e-commerce, SaaS, and lead-generation teams.
payload.longDescription:
ConvRadar 可找出网站转化流失之处，并按优先级排列待修复问题。

连接你的 Google Analytics 4 媒体资源并请求审计。ConvRadar 会读取你的 GA4 数据，返回与上一周期对比的核心 KPI、转化漏斗中最大的流失点、经过显著性检验的异常，以及 2-5 项排序后的发现；每项发现都会匹配到精选的 CRO 假设库。该库包含 43 个类别的 184 项假设，依据已发表的转化研究构建。

你可以：
- 通过一条提示运行完整转化审计
- 找出漏斗中最大的流失点及导致流失的细分群体
- 通过显著性检验比较移动端与桌面端、付费与自然流量，或任意两个细分群体
- 检查任意页面的加载速度和移动端 UX 问题，无需 GA4
- 将转化率和 AOV 与所在行业基准进行比较
- 记录已发布的改动并衡量其是否确实有效

ConvRadar 只读取你所连接媒体资源中的汇总 GA4 指标。它绝不读取原始用户级数据，也不会读取你的 ChatGPT 对话。

适用于电商、SaaS 和潜在客户开发团队。

payload.name: Northeast Telemetry
payload.description: 与你的传感器数据对话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Northeast Telemetry customer account to ask questions about the equipment, systems, spaces, and properties you monitor.

Review current sensor readings, historical trends, and available recent device alarms across your authorized dashboards. Ask for a short explanation or detailed calculations, units, dates, and data limitations. Available information depends on your installed sensors, published dashboard configuration, permissions, and retained history.

Explore changes over time with interactive charts and bounded historical analysis. Broad periods use sampled charts and server-side summaries rather than returning every data point. Exact statistics and energy estimates use source observations and identify missing history; an incomplete period is not presented as a complete total.

Where your account owner has configured approved controls, request an exact shared-attribute or client-attribute setting change. Each action requires the appropriate permission and your separate approval in the conversation before execution. ChatGPT or Codex may also request permission according to your connection settings. The plugin cannot choose arbitrary settings or values, send RPC commands, or change dashboard layouts. A stored setting is not independent confirmation of physical equipment state.

Northeast Telemetry does not guarantee detection or prevention of equipment failures or property problems, provide emergency response, or replace code-required safety devices, professional inspection, maintenance, repair, or life-safety systems.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Northeast Telemetry 客户账户，询问所监控的设备、系统、空间和房产。

查看当前传感器读数、历史趋势，以及授权仪表板中的近期设备警报。你可以请求简短说明，也可以要求提供详细计算、单位、日期和数据限制。可用信息取决于已安装的传感器、已发布的仪表板配置、权限和保留的历史记录。

通过交互式图表和限定范围的历史分析探索变化趋势。较长时间段使用抽样图表和服务器端摘要，而不会返回每个数据点。精确统计和能耗估算依据源观测数据，并会标出缺失的历史记录；不会将不完整时段呈现为完整总计。

如果账户所有者已配置获准的控制项，你可以请求更改精确的共享属性或客户端属性设置。每项操作都需要相应权限，并且必须在执行前于对话中单独获得你的批准。ChatGPT 或 Codex 也可能根据连接设置请求权限。该插件无法选择任意设置或数值、发送 RPC 命令或更改仪表板布局。已存储的设置不能独立证明实体设备的实际状态。

Northeast Telemetry 不保证能够检测或预防设备故障或财产问题，不提供紧急响应，也不能替代法规要求的安全装置、专业检查、维护、维修或生命安全系统。

payload.name: Microstat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microstat brings social media analytics into ChatGPT. Explore connected communities, compare available follower trends and post performance, search collected posts, and export reports. Compare recent posts from supported public VK, Telegram and Odnoklassniki communities by URL. Use archived posts and approved brand knowledge as context for drafting copy. Available metrics and historical coverage depend on the platform, granted access and collected data; unavailable metrics are reported as missing. Microstat does not publish or delete social media posts. Some tools update Microstat settings, imports or report schedules when requested.
payload.longDescription: Microstat 将社交媒体分析带入 ChatGPT。你可以查看已连接的社群、比较可用的关注者趋势和帖子表现、搜索已收集的帖子，并导出报告。通过网址比较受支持的 VK、Telegram 和 Odnoklassniki 公开社群近期帖子。起草文案时，可以将已存档的帖子和获批的品牌知识用作上下文。可用指标和历史覆盖范围取决于平台、已授予的访问权限和已收集的数据；无法提供的指标会标记为缺失。Microstat 不会发布或删除社交媒体帖子。部分工具会在收到请求后更新 Microstat 设置、导入任务或报告计划。

payload.name: Normalic Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Normalic Assistant connects ChatGPT to your organization's Normalic account, so you can ask about your manufacturing data without leaving the conversation.

Ask about workstation performance, production reports, detected insights and anomalies, product and operator productivity, and tracked tasks — the same assistant available inside the Normalic app.

Each person connects with their own Normalic login — there's no shared account or API key. Requires an existing Normalic account with the MCP Assistant feature enabled for your organization.
payload.longDescription:
Normalic Assistant 将 ChatGPT 连接到你所在组织的 Normalic 账户，让你无需离开对话就能询问制造业数据。

你可以询问工作站表现、生产报告、检测到的洞察和异常、产品与操作员效率，以及跟踪的任务——这些功能与 Normalic 应用内的助手相同。

每个人都使用自己的 Normalic 登录账户进行连接——没有共享账户或 API 密钥。需要拥有现有 Normalic 账户，并且组织已启用 MCP Assistant 功能。

payload.name: InfiniteWatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InfiniteWatch brings customer interaction data and operational context from voice calls, text conversations, and web sessions directly into ChatGPT. Authorized sales, customer support, QA, CX, and operations teams can ask natural-language questions to uncover top issues, find supporting examples, analyze trends, compare channels, identify operational risks, evaluate agent performance, access relevant how-to guidance, and summarize customer interactions.

The connector uses InfiniteWatch authentication and organization selection. Each connection and tool call is scoped to the user’s selected organization, ensuring users can access only the data available to them within that organization.

The connector is read-only. It retrieves and analyzes existing InfiniteWatch data but cannot create, modify, delete, export, send, or otherwise change customer interaction data.
payload.longDescription:
InfiniteWatch 将语音通话、文字对话和网页会话中的客户互动数据及运营背景直接带入 ChatGPT。获授权的销售、客户支持、QA、CX 和运营团队可以用自然语言提问，发现主要问题、查找佐证示例、分析趋势、比较渠道、识别运营风险、评估客服表现、获取相关操作指南并总结客户互动。

连接器使用 InfiniteWatch 身份验证并选择组织。每次连接和工具调用都限定在用户所选组织内，确保用户只能访问该组织中对其开放的数据。

此连接器为只读。它会检索和分析现有 InfiniteWatch 数据，但不能创建、修改、删除、导出、发送或以其他方式更改客户互动数据。

payload.name: MerchantFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MerchantFlow connects ChatGPT to the ecommerce data in your MerchantFlow workspace. Explore profit and loss, compare periods, rank products by net profit, review ad spend, and measure cost-of-goods coverage. Additional capabilities cover orders, customer lifetime value, inventory, store audits, and reports.

The connector provides read-only access to your authorized workspace through OAuth, including an interactive profit-and-loss view. Results reflect the integrations, available history, data coverage, and plan capabilities of your MerchantFlow account.

A MerchantFlow account is required. Access can be revoked from MerchantFlow Settings > Developer > MCP.
payload.longDescription:
MerchantFlow将ChatGPT与您MerchantFlow工作区中的电商数据连接起来。查看盈亏情况，对比不同时期数据，按净利润排名产品，审查广告支出并测算商品成本覆盖率。其他功能涵盖订单管理、客户终身价值、库存管理、门店审计及报表生成。

该连接器通过OAuth为您提供授权工作区的只读访问权限，包含交互式盈亏视图。显示结果将反映您MerchantFlow账户的集成情况、可用历史数据、数据覆盖范围及计划功能。

需要拥有MerchantFlow账户方可使用。可通过MerchantFlow设置 > 开发者 > MCP撤销访问权限。

payload.name: Otnox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Otnox helps suppliers find and assess public procurement opportunities directly in ChatGPT.

What you can ask:
- Search open tenders by country, category, keyword, deadline and value across 85 national procurement markets in Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia.
- Open a tender: buyer, deadline, estimated value and a link to the published notice.
- Look up a contracting authority: what it buys, how much, and which suppliers win.
- Check the competition on a tender: number of bidders, single-bidder history, recurring winners.
- Ask whether to bid: a fit assessment against your saved company profile. Each new assessment uses 5 assessment credits from your Otnox account.

On first use the app helps you set up your account: it asks which markets you sell in and what your company does, then saves the markets and the matching procurement categories to your profile.

An Otnox account is required. The markets and features available to you depend on your plan; the app says so when something is outside it.
payload.longDescription:
Otnox 帮助供应商直接在 ChatGPT 中寻找并评估公共采购机会。

你可以：
- 按国家、类别、关键词、截止日期和金额搜索 85 个国家采购市场（覆盖欧洲、拉丁美洲、非洲和亚洲）的开放招标。
- 打开招标信息：买方、截止日期、预计金额及已发布公告链接。
- 查询采购机构：采购内容、采购金额及中标供应商。
- 检查某项招标的竞争情况：投标人数、单一投标人历史和重复中标者。
- 询问是否应投标：根据已保存的公司档案进行匹配评估。每次新评估会消耗 Otnox

账户中的 5 个评估额度。
首次使用时，应用会帮助设置账户：询问你销售的市场和公司业务，然后将市场及匹配的采购类别保存到档案。

需要 Otnox 账户。可用市场和功能取决于套餐；超出套餐范围时，应用会明确说明。

payload.name: Orion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Orion works 24/7, analyzing trends, uncovering opportunities, and teeing up your next move before you even log in. Your data is only telling half the story. Orion connects your business metrics with external data sources.
payload.longDescription: Orion 24/7 全天候运行，在你登录前分析趋势、发现机会并准备下一步行动。你的数据只讲述了一半故事，Orion 将业务指标与外部数据源连接起来。

payload.name: Enrow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.

What it does:
• Find a professional email address from a full name and a company name or domain, one at a time or in bulk?
• Verify whether an email address is deliverable, including on catch-all domains, single or in bulk.
• Find a mobile phone number from a LinkedIn profile URL, or from a name and company, single or in bulk.
• Check your Enrow credit balance and registered webhooks.

How it works: 
Searches are asynchronous. 
A find or verify tool starts a search and returns an id. ChatGPT then retrieves the result with the matching get tool. Bulk jobs of substantial volume can take several minutes.

What it is not for: it does not search or read the mailbox of the user, write emails, look up general customer-service numbers, or provide personal (non-professional) contact details.

Requires an Enrow account. Get started at https://enrow.io.
payload.longDescription:
Enrow 可从完整姓名和公司名称或域名查找专业邮箱（单个或批量），并验证邮箱是否可投递（包括
catc

h-all 域名）；还可从 LinkedIn 个人资料 URL，或姓名和公司查找手机号码，查询 Enro

w 额度余额和已注册 webhook。搜索为异步操作：查找或验证工具会启动搜索并返回
ID，ChatGPT

随后用匹配的获取工具检索结果；大量批处理可能需要几分钟。它不会搜索或读取用户邮箱、写邮件、查找一般客服

号码，也不提供个人（非职业）联系方式。需要
Enrow 账户。开始使用：https://enrow.io。

payload.name: Nanga
payload.description: 您的营销数据，只读模式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nanga is the B2B marketing analytics platform built by Spark (Paris), used by e-commerce and lead generation companies to follow their advertising, creative and SEO performance.

This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your existing Nanga account, for one company chosen when you connect, under your own Nanga permissions. Ask ChatGPT about your advertising: spend, ROAS, CPA and the other metrics your company defines, computed with your own definitions; what moved between two periods and which campaign or platform carries a deterioration; whether data really landed for every platform before you compare; how the account is doing over a period against the previous one; where you stand among comparable companies, anonymously; and what your online store collected next to advertising spend. ChatGPT can also read your saved dashboard analyses and your company context.

Figures are computed by Nanga, not by ChatGPT, and every answer carries its dates, units and definitions. A metric Nanga cannot compute for your company is named as such, never shown as a zero.

You choose what ChatGPT may read when you connect: company context, recent advertising figures and online store sales are three separate permissions. The connector never writes: it changes no campaign, generates no analysis and creates no account. You can revoke access at any time from your Nanga account or from ChatGPT.

An existing Nanga account is required, and your company must have the connector enabled by the Nanga team.
payload.longDescription:
Nanga是由巴黎的Spark打造的B2B营销分析平台，电商公司和获客公司使用该平台跟踪广告、创意和SEO表现。

此连接器为ChatGPT提供只读访问权限，可访问您已有的Nanga账户中选定的单一公司数据，具体公司需在连接时选择，并受您自身的Nanga权限限制。
您可以向ChatGPT咨询广告支出、ROAS、CPA以及其他公司定义的指标，所有数据均基于您自定义的计算规则；查询两个周期间的数据变动情况，以及哪个广告活动或平台导致了表现下滑；确认对比前所有平台的数据是否真实落地；查看账户在特定周期内相较前一周期的表现；了解您在匿名对比公司中的位置，以及在线商店除广告支出外的其他数据。
ChatGPT还可读取您保存的仪表盘分析结果和公司背景信息。

所有数据均由Nanga计算，而非ChatGPT处理，每个回答均会标注日期、单位和计算定义。
若Nanga无法为您的公司计算某项指标，将直接标注该名称，而非显示零值。

连接时您可选择ChatGPT的访问范围：公司背景、近期广告数据和在线商店销售数据为三项独立权限。
该连接器永不写入数据：不会修改广告活动、不会生成分析报告，也不会创建账户。
您可随时通过Nanga账户或ChatGPT撤销访问权限。

需要已有的Nanga账户，且您的公司必须由Nanga团队开启该连接器权限。

payload.name: Fodda Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fodda connects ChatGPT to expert-curated knowledge graphs across retail, consumer goods, technology, sustainability, culture, and finance.

Use it to research emerging market and consumer trends, track a brand's footprint and competitive landscape, and read what executives are actually saying in quarterly earnings calls. You can also consult named industry experts and their AI counterparts for a domain perspective on a specific question.

Every answer is grounded in graphs maintained by real analysts, and each finding comes with its source evidence and attribution, so you can see where an insight came from and follow it back to the original quote or report.
payload.longDescription:
Fodda将ChatGPT与跨零售、消费品、科技、可持续发展、文化及金融领域的专家精选知识图谱连接起来。

可用于研究新兴市场和消费趋势，追踪品牌的影响力及竞争格局，并查看高管在季度财报电话会议中实际表达的内容。您还可以咨询特定行业专家及其AI助手，获取针对具体问题的专业视角。

每个答案均基于分析师维护的知识图谱，每项发现都附带来源证据和出处信息，您可以查看洞察来源并追溯至原始引用或报告。

payload.name: Omnia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omnia is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that tracks how AI models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity perceive and cite your brand. Connect to Omnia to query brand visibility metrics, share of voice, sentiment trends, and citation data across LLM outputs. Monitor how your brand compares to competitors in AI-generated responses, track prompt-level performance over time, and pull structured analytics to inform content and positioning strategy.
payload.longDescription: Omnia 是一个 GEO（生成式引擎优化）平台，可跟踪 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 等 AI 模型如何看待并引用你的品牌。连接 Omnia 后，可查询品牌曝光指标、声量份额、情绪趋势，以及大型语言模型输出中的引用数据。监控品牌在 AI 生成回答中与竞争对手的表现对比，跟踪提示词层面的效果变化，并获取结构化分析数据，为内容和定位策略提供依据。

payload.name: WatchMyCompetitor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your organisation’s authorised WatchMyCompetitor intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask about tracked companies, recent competitor activity, product launches and market signals; compare strategic moves; and create evidence-backed executive briefings with source links. The plugin is read-only and only accesses the WMC account associated with the authenticated user. An active WatchMyCompetitor subscription and configured user account are required.
payload.longDescription: 将组织获准访问的 WatchMyCompetitor 情报接入 ChatGPT。询问已跟踪的公司、近期竞争对手动态、产品发布和市场信号；比较战略举措；并创建附有来源链接、以证据为依据的高管简报。该插件为只读，仅访问与已通过身份验证的用户关联的 WMC 账户。使用需要有效的 WatchMyCompetitor 订阅和已配置的用户账户。

payload.name: EBHOOM EMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EBHOOM EMS is a read-only environmental monitoring assistant for authorized industrial users. It connects to the EBHOOM Environmental Management System to provide live station status, current parameter readings, exceedances, daily averages, and recent data-gap information.

The plugin does not modify monitoring data, change device configuration, control equipment, or perform administrative actions. Users can only access the stations and environmental data permitted for their authenticated account.
payload.longDescription:
EBHOOM EMS 是一款只读环境监测助手，供获授权的工业用户使用。它连接到 EBHOOM Environmental Management System，提供站点实时状态、当前参数读数、超标情况、日均值和近期数据缺口信息。

此插件不会修改监测数据、更改设备配置、控制设备或执行管理操作。用户只能访问其已验证账户获准访问的站点和环境数据。

payload.name: Wren AI
payload.description: 向数据库提问并获取答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wren AI brings conversational business intelligence (GenBI) into ChatGPT. Connect your company's databases, ask questions in free-form language, and get answers from live data with the SQL, visuals, and context behind them.

Ask "What was revenue by region last quarter?" and Wren AI generates the SQL, runs it against your warehouse, and returns the result with a short summary or chart. Every query is built on your team's semantic model - the business definitions, metrics, and joins your data team already maintains - so ChatGPT uses the same terms and logic your analysts do instead of guessing at table names.

What you can do:
- Ask questions and get answers with the SQL shown
- Generate SQL from a question without running it
- Run a query and get results back
- Summarize results or turn them into a chart
- Switch between the Wren AI projects you have access to
payload.longDescription:
Wren AI 将对话式商业智能（GenBI）引入 ChatGPT。连接公司的数据库，用自由表达的语言提问，即可从实时数据中获得答案，以及背后的 SQL、可视化内容和上下文。

询问“上季度各地区的收入是多少？”，Wren AI 就会生成 SQL，在数据仓库中运行查询，并返回结果及简短摘要或图表。每个查询都基于团队的语义模型——即数据团队维护的业务定义、指标和关联关系——因此 ChatGPT 使用的是与你的分析师相同的术语和逻辑，而不会猜测表名。

你可以：
- 提问并获取显示 SQL 的答案
- 根据问题生成 SQL，但不运行
- 运行查询并获取结果
- 总结结果或将其转化为图表
- 在你有权访问的 Wren AI 项目之间切换

payload.name: v2v
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare real estate in Albania from ChatGPT. V2V helps users find apartments, villas, houses and new builds for sale or rent using structured filters such as city, budget, property type and distance to the sea. Results include listing facts, market context and source links so users can continue due diligence on v2v.al or with the original listing source.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中搜索并比较阿尔巴尼亚的房地产。V2V 帮助用户根据城市、预算、房产类型和距海距离等结构化筛选条件，查找待售或待租的公寓、别墅、住宅和新建房产。结果包含房源事实、市场背景和来源链接，方便用户在 v2v.al 或原始房源网站继续尽职调查。

payload.name: Pressure Atlas
payload.description: 了解 AI 的宏观压力背景
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pressure Atlas is a daily macro pressure gauge that helps you and your AI understand the broader environment behind markets and headlines.

Like barometric pressure in weather, it provides one important measurement within a larger picture: whether macro pressure is building or releasing, how much pressure is present, and whether its pace is increasing or slowing.

Use it to bring consistent macro context into your research, AI conversations, and analytical models. Explore recent readings, compare changing conditions, and consider how the broader environment fits alongside your own data and analysis.

Each daily reading includes a 0–5 value, a plain-language label, and direction and pace indicators. Pressure Atlas measures conditions—it does not provide predictions or recommendations.
payload.longDescription:
该插件了解 AI 的宏观压力背景。以下功能和限制适用：

Pressure Atlas is a daily macro pressure gauge that helps you and your AI understand the broader environment behind markets and headlines.

Like barometric pressure in weather, it provides one important measurement within a larger picture: whether macro pressure is building or releasing, how much pressure is present, and whether its pace is increasing or slowing.

Use it to bring consistent macro context into your research, AI conversations, and analytical models. Explore recent readings, compare changing conditions, and consider how the broader environment fits alongside your own data and analysis.
Each daily reading includes a 0–5 value, a plain-language label, and direction and pace indicators. Pressure Atlas measures conditions—it does not provide predictions or recommendations.

payload.name: Lightreel
payload.description: 社交媒体与 Meta 广告研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lightreel helps you research TikTok, Instagram, and Meta ads to find influencers and micro-creators, develop viral strategies, find ad formats, and explore content. Think of it as your 24/7 marketing intern.
payload.longDescription: Lightreel 帮助研究 TikTok、Instagram 和 Meta 广告，寻找网红和微型创作者、制定病毒式传播策略、发现广告格式并探索内容，可作为 24/7 全天候营销助手。

payload.name: Adzviser TikTok Ads
payload.summaryOriginal: Talk to your TikTok Ads data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your TikTok Ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, measure performance, and see which creatives are actually working.

Compare impressions, clicks, video views, cost per result, conversions, and return on ad spend across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, ad group, ad, or creative. Turn your TikTok advertising data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将TikTok Ads数据连接到ChatGPT。用日常语言提问，追踪支出、衡量表现，并查看哪些创意素材真正有效。

比较不同日期范围内的展示次数、点击次数、视频观看次数、单次结果成本、转化和广告支出回报率。按广告系列、广告组、广告或创意素材细分结果。将TikTok广告数据转为清晰报告，找出预算发挥作用的地方。

payload.name: USDT & USDC Blacklist Tracker
payload.description: 查询任何钱包是否被冻结
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check any wallet against the on-chain record of stablecoin freezes and blacklists. Eagle Virtual tracks what Tether, Circle and other stablecoin issuers have done to wallets: USDT blacklistings, USDC freezes, seizures and releases. Every entry is a dated record of an action a named issuer took, with the transaction and block so anyone can check it against the chain.

Ask it: is this wallet on the USDT blacklist, has Circle frozen this USDC address, which stablecoins can freeze a balance, what are the largest seizures on record, and what was frozen recently on Tron or Ethereum. It covers 35 blockchains and 444 coins as of 12 September 2026, and cites a public page for every record it returns.

It does not score addresses, assign risk, give advice or make predictions, and it is not a government sanctions screening service. It reports what issuers published on-chain.
payload.longDescription:
根据链上稳定币冻结和黑名单记录检查任意钱包。Eagle Virtual 跟踪 Tether、Circle 和其他稳定币发行方对钱包采取的操作：USDT 列入黑名单、USDC 冻结、资产扣押与解冻。每条记录都列明具名发行方采取操作的日期，并提供交易和区块信息，任何人都可以据此在链上核验。

你可以询问：这个钱包是否在 USDT 黑名单上？Circle 是否冻结了这个 USDC 地址？哪些稳定币可以冻结余额？有记录以来最大规模的扣押有哪些？Tron 或 Ethereum 上最近冻结了什么？该应用涵盖 35 条区块链和 444 种代币（截至 12 September 2026），并为返回的每条记录提供公开页面引用。

它不会为地址评分、判定风险、提供建议或作出预测，也不是政府制裁筛查服务。它只报告发行方公布在链上的信息。

payload.name: Seline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Seline to ChatGPT to explore your website analytics in natural language.

Ask questions about traffic, visitors, pages, events, funnels, referrers, conversions, and trends without digging through dashboards or writing queries. Seline gives ChatGPT access to your analytics data so you can quickly understand what’s happening on your site, investigate changes, compare periods, and uncover useful insights from your visitors’ behavior.

Use it to answer questions like “What caused traffic to increase this week?”, “Which pages bring in the most engaged visitors?”, or “How is this month performing compared with last month?”
payload.longDescription:
将 Seline 连接到 ChatGPT，用自然语言探索网站分析数据。

无需翻看仪表板或编写查询，即可询问流量、访客、页面、事件、漏斗、引荐来源、转化和趋势。Seline 让 ChatGPT 访问你的分析数据，帮助你快速了解网站情况、调查变化、比较不同时期，并从访客行为中发现有用洞见。

你可以用它回答诸如“本周流量为何上升？”“哪些页面带来的访客参与度最高？”或“本月表现与上月相比如何？”等问题。

payload.name: Agenticaso
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agenticaso scans public websites for signals that help AI agents find, understand, recommend, and transact with a brand. It returns an AI-agent readiness score across four pillars—Found, Understood, Recommended, and Bought—along with evidence-based priority fixes. No account is required to scan a public website.
payload.longDescription: Agenticaso 扫描公开网站，查找有助于AI智能体发现、理解、推荐品牌并与其交易的信号。它从4个方面——被发现、被理解、被推荐和被购买——给出AI智能体就绪评分，并提供基于证据的优先修复建议。扫描公开网站无需账户。

payload.name: Nectar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nectar Social connects ChatGPT to your brand's social performance, competitor benchmarks, and community conversations across platforms.

Ask how your content performed this week, how a competitor's launch landed, or what your customers are complaining about in the comments across paid and organic, and get answers grounded in real social data, combined with everything else ChatGPT knows about your business.

Built for marketing, social, influencer, and competitive intelligence teams and agencies who want faster, data-grounded decisions.

Requires a Nectar Social account (https://www.nectarsocial.com).
payload.longDescription:
Nectar Social 将 ChatGPT 连接到品牌在各平台的社交表现、竞争对手基准和社区对话。
询

问本周内容表现、竞争对手发布会效果，或客户在付费和自然内容评论中抱怨什么，即可获得基于真实社交数据并结合

ChatGPT 对你业务了解的答案。
面向希望更快做出数据驱动决策的营销、社交、网红和竞争情报团队及代理机

构。
需要 Nectar Social 账户（https://www.nectarsocial.com）。

payload.name: Adzviser Search Ads 360
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Search Ads 360 data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend across search engines and see which campaigns and keywords are earning their budget.

Compare impressions, clicks, click-through rate, cost per click, conversions, and return on ad spend across date ranges. Break results down by advertiser, engine account, campaign, ad group, or keyword. Turn your search data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Adzviser 将 Search Ads 360 数据连接到 ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，跟踪各搜索引擎的支出，查看哪些广告系列和关键词值得投入预算。

比较不同日期范围内的展示次数、点击次数、点击率、每次点击成本、转化次数和广告支出回报率。按广告主、引擎账号、广告系列、广告组或关键词拆分结果。将搜索广告数据转为清晰报告，找出预算发挥作用的地方。

payload.name: Microburbs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microburbs is Australia's most comprehensive and accurate provider of property and geospatial data. Established in 2013, it holds over 5 billion data points covering every Australian address, street and suburb, and it is the only provider of granular street- and mesh-block-level data. Ask about any suburb or property and get answers grounded in that data: back-tested price forecasts, median prices and rents, yields and days on market, crime compared with the national median, school catchments and rankings, flood and bushfire risk, zoning and development, and census demographics. Without an account, answers cover nine sample suburbs, one in each state and territory: Bondi, Belmont North, St Kilda (Vic.), Fortitude Valley, Subiaco, Unley, Sandy Bay, Kambah and Nightcliff.
payload.longDescription: Microburbs 是澳大利亚最全面、最准确的房产和地理空间数据提供商。公司成立于 2013 年，拥有覆盖澳大利亚每个地址、街道和郊区的 50 多亿个数据点，是唯一提供细粒度街道和网格区块级数据的提供商。询问任意郊区或房产，即可获得基于这些数据的回答：经过回测的价格预测、中位数价格和租金、收益率和上市天数、与全国中位数相比的犯罪情况、学区范围和排名、洪水及丛林火灾风险、分区和开发情况，以及人口普查人口统计数据。没有账户时，回答覆盖九个示例郊区，每个州和领地各一个：Bondi、Belmont North、St Kilda（维多利亚州）、Fortitude Valley、Subiaco、Unley、Sandy Bay、Kambah 和 Nightcliff。

payload.name: YPulse Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.

It tracks brand perception (awareness, favorability, usage), behavioral trends (spending, social media, entertainment, finance, health, dating), and publishes editorial content/reports on youth culture. It doesn't cover Gen X, Boomers, or anyone over 40.
payload.longDescription:
YPulse 是一家专注于 Z 世代和千禧一代（13–39 岁）的研究服务，覆盖北美和西欧的中童、青少年、大学生、年轻成年人和年轻父母，并拥有十多年的联合调查数据。

它跟踪品牌认知（知名度、好感度、使用情况）、行为趋势（消费、社交媒体、娱乐、金融、健康、约会），并发布有关青年文化的编辑内容和报告。它不涵盖 X 世代、婴儿潮一代或任何 40 岁以上人群。

payload.name: Vibewatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT access to your community's vibe. Vibewatch is community intelligence for web3 teams: it reads your community across Discord, Telegram, X, and more, scores the vibe, surfaces daily insights, and writes weekly reports. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Vibewatch organization through the hosted Vibewatch MCP server — sentiment overview, daily trend, message search, daily insights, weekly reports, market context, and the public Stacks ecosystem index, all read-only. Sign in with your Vibewatch account.
payload.longDescription: 让 ChatGPT 了解你所在社区的氛围。Vibewatch 是面向 web3 团队的社区情报工具：它读取 Discord、Telegram、X 等平台上的社区内容，对社区情绪打分，呈现每日洞察并撰写周报。此插件通过托管的 Vibewatch MCP 服务器，将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 Vibewatch 组织，提供情绪概览、每日趋势、消息搜索、每日洞察、周报、市场背景和公开的 Stacks 生态系统索引，所有功能均为只读。请使用你的 Vibewatch 账户登录。

payload.name: Plota: Planning Applications
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plota brings UK planning applications and planning permission records into ChatGPT. Ask about any address, postcode, street or council in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland and get the applications themselves: the proposal, status and decision, key dates, and a link to the official council record.

What you can ask:

- What has been applied for at or near an address, and what is pending next door
- Everything about one site in a single answer: its applications, related amendments and appeals, larger -housing schemes nearby, and planning constraints such as flood zones, conservation areas, listed buildings and green belt
- How long a council takes to decide planning applications, and how often it approves them
- Planning appeals and their outcomes, and planning permissions that are about to lapse
- New applications by type, size or number of homes, across a town, a council or the whole country

Used by homeowners checking what is planned nearby, and by architects, planning consultants, developers, property professionals and suppliers tracking new work. Records are collected daily from council planning registers, and every answer links back to its source.

Sign in with your Plota account, or enter your email to start on the free demo allowance. Some features, such as site constraints, depend on your Plota plan.
payload.longDescription:
Plota 将英国规划申请和规划许可记录引入 ChatGPT。您可以询问英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰的任意地址、邮政编码、街道或市政委员会，并获取具体申请信息：提案、状态和决定、关键日期，以及官方市政委员会记录链接。

您可以询问：

- 某个地址或附近提交了哪些申请，以及隔壁有哪些申请正在等待处理
- 某个地点的完整信息：其申请、相关修订和上诉、附近的大型住房项目，以及洪水区、保护区、登录建筑和绿化带等规划限制
- 市政委员会审批规划申请需要多长时间，以及批准频率
- 规划上诉及其结果，以及即将失效的规划许可
- 某个城镇、某个市政委员会或全国范围内按类型、规模或住房数量筛选的新申请

房主可借此查询附近的规划项目；建筑师、规划顾问、开发商、房地产专业人士和供应商则可追踪新项目。记录每日从市政委员会的规划登记系统收集，每条回答都会链接回来源。

使用 Plota 账户登录，或输入电子邮箱开始使用免费演示额度。部分功能（例如场地限制信息）取决于您的 Plota 方案。

payload.name: Personyze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.

Typical uses: "which campaigns lost conversion rate last week", "add everyone who viewed the pricing page to the Enterprise Prospects audience", "draft a banner for returning visitors from paid search", "what did this visitor do before they converted".

Read and write are both supported; every action runs under the permissions of the account that authorized the connection, and access is revoked by deleting the API key in Personyze under Integrations.
payload.longDescription:
Personyze 是一个网站个性化和 A/B 测试平台。此应用可让 ChatGPT 直接操作您的 Personyze 账户：查看营销活动的表现、检查并起草个性化操作、搜索和更新访客资料，以及管理受众群体——全程通过对话完成，无需编写代码或打开控制面板。

常见用途：“上周哪些营销活动的转化率下降了？”“把所有浏览过定价页面的人加入 Enterprise Prospects 受众群体。”“为来自付费搜索渠道的回访访客起草一个横幅。”“这位访客转化之前做了什么？”

读取和写入操作均受支持；每项操作都遵循授权连接的账户权限。您可以在 Personyze 的 Integrations 中删除 API 密钥，以撤销访问权限。

payload.name: ラッコキーワード
payload.description: 关键词/竞品分析工具（SEO 与营销调研）
payload.summaryOriginal: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。
payload.longDescription:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）是日本规模最大的关键词研究工具之一。使用此插件，你可以直接在 ChatGPT 对话中进行关键词研究和 SEO 分析。

可执行的操作：
・获取 Google、Bing、YouTube、Amazon、乐天等平台的建议关键词
・从专属数据库获取相关关键词和常见问题
・探索 LSI 关键词、其他用户还会询问的问题（PAA）及共同排名关键词等相关主题
・获取月均搜索量、SEO 难度、CPC 和竞争度（含按月趋势）
・实测 Google 搜索排名
・竞品分析：提取任意域名覆盖的关键词和主要引流页面
・搜索通过指定关键词获得自然搜索流量的页面和网站
・SEO 写作辅助：提取搜索排名靠前页面的标题结构和共现词

使用示例：
・设计 SEO 文章的大纲、标题和小标题
・策划内容、寻找选题并调研市场和需求
・分析竞品网站通过自然搜索获取流量的关键词
・调研电商（Amazon、乐天）商品

该工具擅长日本搜索市场数据，查询月均搜索量时也支持指定海外地区和语言。使用需要ラッコキーワード账号。

payload.name: Seal Copilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seal Copilot turns your Sealmetrics data into decisions: a verdict first, the evidence with numbers, one action, and a date to check it.

It diagnoses drops down to the campaign that caused them, finds revenue left on the table, audits catalog friction per product, watches the cart during the day against a learned baseline, and reviews your tracking setup. Fourteen procedures over one methodology, with playbooks for ecommerce, hotels and SaaS that it picks from your own tracking.

Every figure comes from a tool result in the same session: it never invents a number, and it refuses to conclude when the sample is too small. Requires a Sealmetrics account.
payload.longDescription:
Seal Copilot 将你的 Sealmetrics 数据转化为决策：先给出结论，再列出带数字的证据、一个行动建议和检查日期。

它能追查导致下滑的具体营销活动，发现未能获取的收入，按产品审查商品目录中的阻碍，根据学习得出的基线在白天监控购物车，并检查跟踪设置。它基于一种方法论执行十四项流程，并根据你自己的跟踪数据为电商、酒店和 SaaS 选择相应操作手册。

每个数字都来自同一会话中的工具结果：绝不编造数字；样本过小时会拒绝下结论。需要 Sealmetrics 账户。

payload.name: Leadstore.xyz: AI Visibility
payload.summaryOriginal: SEO, AEO, GEO, LLMO and ASO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leadstore tracks how your brand shows up in AI search — ChatGPT, Google, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Grok — and helps you act on what it finds.

Connect your Leadstore account and ask for things that would otherwise take several dashboards: your AI visibility score and the prompts you are cited in, share of voice against tracked competitors, keyword and content gaps, technical audit findings, and where your brand is being discussed on other sites.

You can also work on content in the conversation. Read a blog draft together with its quality report and the plan it was written from, edit the parts that need work, and watch the score update — then schedule or publish it to a connected CMS such as WordPress, Sanity or Framer.

The plugin acts as you, using your own Leadstore login through a standard OAuth sign-in, and you can revoke access at any time. A Leadstore account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Leadstore追踪你的品牌在AI搜索中的展现情况——包括ChatGPT、Google、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity和Grok——并帮助你根据发现结果采取行动。

连接你的Leadstore账户，通过单一界面获取原本需要多个仪表盘查看的信息：你的AI可见性评分以及被引用的提示语、与追踪竞品的声量份额、关键词和内容缺口、技术审计结果，以及品牌在其他网站的讨论位置。

你还可以在对话中直接处理内容。与团队共同阅读博客草稿及其质量报告和创作计划，编辑需要修改的部分，实时查看评分变化——随后可将内容安排发布至WordPress、Sanity或Framer等连接的内容管理系统。

该插件通过标准OAuth登录使用你的Leadstore账号，你可随时撤销访问权限。需要注册Leadstore账户。

payload.name: Laup
payload.description: 追踪 AI 如何推荐你
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Laup tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and Claude answer the buying questions your customers ask, and whether they recommend your business or a competitor. This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT so you can explore it in conversation.

Ask for your AI visibility per engine and product category, read the exact answers for a prompt, see which websites the engines used as sources, and review the web searches they ran. You can also check your site's AI readiness and work through your Laup action plan: evaluate and verify recommendations, triage them and add comments.

Requires a Laup account with at least one tracked domain.
payload.longDescription:
Laup 追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Copilot 和 Claude 如何回答客户的购买问题，以及它们是否推荐你的企业或竞争对手。此插件将这些数据带入 ChatGPT，方便你在对话中探索。

按引擎和产品类别询问你的 AI 可见度，阅读某个提示词的完整回答，查看引擎使用哪些网站作为来源，并检查它们执行的网络搜索。你还可以检查网站的 AI 就绪度，并处理 Laup 行动计划：评估和验证建议，对其分类处理并添加评论。

需要 Laup 账户，并至少有一个受追踪的域名。

payload.name: Versive
payload.description: 开展调查和 AI 访谈
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Versive lets you run AI-moderated user research from ChatGPT. Create studies that combine fixed survey questions (multiple choice, ratings, NPS, ranking) with adaptive AI-interview questions, organize them with question groups and branching logic, and share a link that participants take as a conversational interview. As responses come in, check completion and drop-off stats, per-question aggregates, and individual interview transcripts, or export everything as CSV — without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: Versive 让你可以在 ChatGPT 中开展由 AI 主持的用户研究。创建结合固定调查问题（单选、多选、评分、NPS、排序）和自适应 AI 访谈问题的研究项目，通过问题组和分支逻辑进行组织，并分享一个链接，让参与者以对话式访谈的方式作答。收到回复后，你可以查看完成率和中途退出统计、各问题的汇总数据及单次访谈转录，也可以导出全部内容为 CSV，全程无需离开聊天。

payload.name: Momently
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Momently is the data platform for modern publishers. It connects social, web, newsletter, and ad platforms in one place and turns them into live dashboards, branded campaign reports, and benchmarks. This plugin gives Momently customers a direct line to that data from ChatGPT.

Ask questions in plain language and get real answers from your own workspace: how campaigns are performing, which platform drove the most impressions, how delivery is pacing against goals, which posts performed best this quarter, or how campaigns for a prospect's category usually perform based on your own history. Results come back with links into Momently, shareable branded PDF reports, and the actual creatives with thumbnails.

Everything is read-only and permission-aware. Each person signs in with their own Momently account, sees only the workspaces they already belong to, and every request is checked against their permissions on every call. The plugin cannot change anything in Momently.

Built for publisher teams: sales pulling benchmarks before a pitch, client services checking pacing and prepping wrap reports, editorial and social teams reviewing content performance, and leadership asking for the quarter in one question.

Requires a Momently workspace with the connector enabled. Visit momently.com/connector for setup guides.
payload.longDescription:
Momently 是面向现代出版商的数据平台。它将社交媒体、网站、电子报和广告平台连接在一起，转化为实时仪表板、品牌化营销活动报告和基准数据。此插件让 Momently 客户能够直接从 ChatGPT 访问这些数据。

使用日常语言提问，即可从自己的工作空间获得真实答案：营销活动表现如何、哪个平台带来的展示次数最多、交付进度与目标相比如何、本季度哪些帖子表现最佳，或者根据自己的历史数据，某个潜在客户所属类别的营销活动通常表现如何。结果会附上 Momently 内部链接、可分享的品牌化 PDF 报告，以及带缩略图的实际创意素材。

所有操作均为只读且遵守权限。每个人都使用自己的 Momently 账户登录，只能查看自己已加入的工作空间；每次调用都会根据其权限进行检查。此插件无法更改 Momently 中的任何内容。

专为出版商团队打造：销售人员可在推介前获取基准数据，客户服务团队可检查进度并准备总结报告，编辑和社交团队可评估内容表现，管理层则可以通过一个问题了解本季度情况。

需要启用连接器的 Momently 工作空间。请访问 momently.com/connector 查看设置指南。

payload.name: 中央社新聞 CNA TAIWAN NEWS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CNA provides a trusted, source-based news search and research service that allows users to search Central News Agency reporting directly within ChatGPT, stay informed about recent developments, and organize the evolving context surrounding specific people, events, and public issues.

Using natural language, users can search CNA news reports as well as content from CNA almanac, special features, and multilingual news coverage in English, Japanese, Indonesian, and other languages. The service also supports searches for standardized translations of foreign names and proper nouns, news photographs, government information, and fact-checking materials, helping users compare information across multiple sources and clarify uncertain claims. It can also organize retrieved information into event timelines, concise topic briefs, newspaper-style layouts, and relationship maps of people and organizations. These capabilities are suitable for news research, event retrospectives, issue tracking, information verification, content planning, and background research.

Responses preserve news headlines, publication dates, source information, and links to original articles whenever possible, allowing users to review the original reporting and conduct further verification. Some search results may come from government agencies, fact-checking organizations, contributed content, or other image sources; the system identifies their origins where available. The use and licensing of images remain subject to the terms, copyright requirements, and other applicable rules of their original sources.
payload.longDescription:
CNA 提供可信、基于来源的新闻搜索与研究服务，让用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索中央通讯社报道，了解近期动态，并梳理特定人物、事件和公共议题不断变化的背景。

用户可以通过自然语言搜索 CNA 新闻报道，以及 CNA 年鉴、专题报道和英语、日语、印尼语等多语言新闻内容。服务还支持搜索外国姓名和专有名词的标准化译名、新闻照片、政府信息及事实核查材料，帮助用户比较多方信息并澄清不确定说法。它还可以将检索信息整理成事件时间线、主题简报、报纸版面和人物/组织关系图。这些功能适用于新闻研究、事件回顾、议题跟踪、信息核验、内容规划和背景调研。

回复会尽可能保留新闻标题、发布日期、来源信息和原文链接，方便用户查阅原始报道并进一步核实。部分搜索结果可能来自政府机构、事实核查组织、投稿内容或其他图片来源；在可用时，系统会标明其来源。图片的使用和授权仍受其原始来源的条款、版权要求及其他适用规则约束。

payload.name: TitanSigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TitanSigma unifies all your data and sends it to your BI tool, simplifying how you track KPIs and metrics.
No more digging through spreadsheets or chasing down reports.
Just clear numbers your team can use to run the business better.
payload.longDescription:
TitanSigma 汇总你的所有数据并将其发送到 BI 工具，让 KPI 和指标跟踪更简单。
不必再翻找电子表格或四处追问报告。
只需清晰的数据，帮助团队更好地经营业务。

payload.name: HFS Research
payload.description: 搜索 HFS Research 网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring HFS Research’s library of knowledge and research into your AI assistant. This connector gives authenticated HFS Research members conversational access to HFS’ published content. This content includes research reports, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, and quick takes. Ask questions and get cited answers drawn straight from HFS analysis.
What you can do: search across everything (semantic search returns the most relevant passages with source report, author, date, and link); filter by type (research, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, or quick takes); browse the latest; find by topic or author; and open a specific item by reference.
It is read-only. The MCP connector retrieves and cites HFS content and never posts, edits, or deletes anything. Access requires an eligible HFS Research membership; you sign in with your HFS account, and results reflect your entitlement. Every answer links back to the HFS Research site so you can read the full report.
payload.longDescription:
将 HFS Research 的知识与研究资料库带入你的 AI 助手。此连接器让已认证的 HFS Research 会员通过对话访问已发布内容，包括研究报告、博客、播客、视频播客和简讯。你可以提问并获取直接基于 HFS 分析且附有引用的回答。
你可以：搜索所有内容（语义搜索会返回最相关段落及来源报告、作者、日期和链接）；按类型筛选（研究、博客、播客、视频播客或简讯）；浏览最新内容；按主题或作者查找；并通过引用打开特定项目。
此连接器为只读，只会检索并引用 HFS 内容，不会发布、编辑或删除任何内容。访问需要符合资格的 HFS Research 会员身份；使用 HFS 账号登录，结果会遵循你的访问权限。每个回答都会链接回 HFS Research 网站，供你阅读完整报告。

payload.name: Flippo AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flippo keeps a reseller's inventory, purchases and sales in one place.

Ask what is still unsold, what a purchase returned, or how much profit a
month brought in, and the answer comes from your own records.

You can look up items, see what has been sitting too long, compare margins
across platforms, and record a sale as it happens.

Requires a Flippo account.
payload.longDescription:
Flippo 将转售商的库存、采购和销售记录集中管理。

询问哪些商品尚未售出、某笔采购带来了多少回报，或某个月赚了多少利润，答案都来自你自己的记录。

你可以查询商品、查看哪些商品积压过久、比较不同平台的利润率，并在售出时记录交易。

需要 Flippo 账户。

payload.name: Advan Research REI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn foot traffic and demographic data into actionable real estate insights. Analyze property performance, compare locations and competitors, understand trade areas and customer profiles, evaluate tenant opportunities, and identify strong sites for retail brands. Built for brokers, landlords, and site selectors who want data-backed answers for leasing, acquisition, renewal, and location decisions.
payload.longDescription: 将客流和人口统计数据转化为可采取行动的房地产洞见。分析物业表现、比较地点和竞争对手、了解商圈和客户画像、评估租户机会，并为零售品牌寻找优质选址。专为希望在租赁、收购、续租和选址决策中获得数据支持答案的经纪人、房东和选址人员打造。

payload.name: Adzviser CallTrackingMetrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CTM data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how many calls and texts your marketing is generating and which channels are driving them.

Compare total calls, answered and missed calls, call duration, and conversions across date ranges. Break results down by tracking number, source, campaign, or agent. Turn your call tracking data into clear reports and see which channels are actually producing conversations.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Adzviser 将CTM数据连接到 ChatGPT。用日常语言提问，了解营销带来了多少通话和短信，以及哪些渠道在推动这些互动。

比较不同日期范围内的总通话数、已接和未接通话、通话时长及转化。按跟踪号码、来源、营销活动或坐席拆分结果。将通话跟踪数据转化为清晰报告，了解哪些渠道真正促成了对话。

payload.name: Index Energia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore data and information about Brazil’s electric power sector with Index Energia. Access prices, market data, system operations, generation, load, hydrology, reservoirs, curtailment, CCEE data, regulatory documents, Brazilian Official Gazette publications, and structured analyses in one place.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Index Energia 探索巴西电力行业数据：价格、市场数据、系统运行、发电、负荷、水文、水库、限电、CCEE 数据、监管文件、巴西官方公报及结构化分析。

payload.name: Inspectform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inspectform helps insurance professionals collect property data to populate applications and Statements of Values (SOVs). Connect your Inspectform account to search U.S. addresses and surface decades of hard-to-find property updates, including available permit histories for roofs, HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems, with source-linked COPE findings.

Coverage and freshness vary by property and source. Searches use your organization’s existing credits and require approved access.

New to Inspectform? Request access at https://inspectform.io/mcp/access.
payload.longDescription:
Inspectform 帮助保险专业人士收集房产数据，用于填写申请表和价值清单（SOV）。关联 Inspectform 账户后，可搜索美国地址并查找难以获取的数十年房屋更新记录，包括可用的屋顶、暖通空调、管道和电气系统许可历史，以及附有来源的 COPE 发现。

不同房产和数据来源的覆盖范围及时效各不相同。搜索会使用你所在组织现有的额度，并且需要获批的访问权限。

刚开始使用 Inspectform？请前往 https://inspectform.io/mcp/access 申请访问权限。

payload.name: HOT AI搜車
payload.description: 搜索并比较公开在售二手车
payload.summaryOriginal: 搜尋與比較公開在售中古車
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HOT AI搜車協助使用者依品牌、車款、預算、年份、里程、車身型式、燃料種類、座位數、保固條件及車商所在地，搜尋並比較目前公開在售的中古車。搜尋結果來自HOT大聯盟的第一方公開庫存；此工具不提供中古車估價、市場行情判定、預約、交易或聯絡車商功能。
payload.longDescription: HOT AI搜车可协助用户根据品牌、车型、预算、年份、里程、车身类型、燃料种类、座位数、保修条件和车商所在地，搜索并比较当前公开在售的二手车。搜索结果来自 HOT 大联盟的第一方公开库存；此工具不提供二手车估价、市场行情判断、预约、交易或联系车商功能。

payload.name: forms.app: Form Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create any online form right in ChatGPT for free and collect unlimited responses.

With forms.app MCP, you can let ChatGPT manage your forms, fetch the responses, get statistics, and do so much more. Whether it’s RSVP forms, research surveys, registration forms, or any other forms, forms.app fits right into your AI workflows.

Example uses:

- Creating forms from a description: "Create an onboarding survey for a branding agency with necessary contact details, brand personality questions, and questions about must-haves"

- Evaluating a form’s performance: "Take a look at my job application form’s content, drop-off rates, and statistics; then tell me about how my form performs, as well as pointers on how to improve its conversions"

- Analyzing submissions: Based on the responses we got from our employee survey, what should be our priority to improve morale and collaboration?

- Visualizing form data: "Get the statistics and drop-off rates of my feedback form; analyze them and create compelling visuals I can use in a presentation"
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中免费创建任意在线表单，并收集无限量回复。

使用 forms.app MCP，可以让 ChatGPT 管理表单、获取回复、查看统计数据等。无论是 RSVP 回复表、研究问卷、注册表还是其他表单，forms.app 都能融入你的 AI 工作流。

使用示例：

- 根据描述创建表单：“为品牌代理公司创建一份入职调查问卷，收集必要的联系方式、品牌个性信息以及必备条件。”

- 评估表单效果：“查看我的求职申请表内容、流失率和统计数据，然后告诉我表单表现如何，以及如何提高转化率。”

- 分析提交内容：根据员工调查问卷的回复，我们应该优先采取哪些措施来改善士气和协作？

- 可视化表单数据：“获取反馈表的统计数据和流失率，进行分析，并创建可用于演示文稿的精彩图表。”

payload.name: social.plus Agentry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
social.plus Agentry connects ChatGPT to the first-party data your app already generates. Ask questions about your community, users, content, activity, and growth in plain language, and get a clear answer ready to visualize, tabulate or dig into with follow-up questions.

Ask things like:
- I'm prepping a campaign brief. What content formats drove the most activity last month, and which user segments engaged the most?
- We launched a new feature last Tuesday. How did user activity change in the days after compared to the week before?
- I have a QBR in an hour. Give me a snapshot of growth, active users, and top-performing content in this quarter.
- What are the trending topics this week? Any notable shifts in what users are talking about?
- Break down our most active user segments by how they engage. Who posts, who comments, who reacts?

Your data stays yours: Agentry is read-only. It never posts, modifies, or deletes anything. Data refreshes daily and covers roughly the last 90 days of activity.

To connect, you'll need a social.plus network with Agentry enabled and a connect code from a Console super admin.
payload.longDescription:
social.plus Agentry 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的应用已生成的第一方数据。你可以用日常语言询问社群、用户、内容、活动和增长情况，并获得清晰答案，以便可视化、制成表格或通过后续问题深入分析。

例如可以询问：
- 我正在准备一份营销活动简报。上个月哪些内容形式带来了最多活动？哪些用户群体参与度最高？
- 我们上周二发布了一项新功能。此后几天的用户活动与前一周相比有何变化？
- 我一小时后要参加 QBR。请概述本季度的增长、活跃用户和表现最佳的内容。
- 本周的热门话题有哪些？用户讨论内容有什么明显变化吗？
- 按参与方式细分最活跃的用户群体：谁发帖、谁评论、谁点赞？

你的数据仍由你掌控：Agentry 采用只读模式。它不会发布、修改或删除任何内容。数据每天刷新，涵盖大约最近 90 days 的活动。

要连接，你需要启用了 Agentry 的 social.plus 网络，以及由 Console 超级管理员提供的连接码。

payload.name: BigQuery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query and manage BigQuery datasets, tables, jobs, and routines.
payload.longDescription: 查询和管理 BigQuery 数据集、表、作业和例程。
